title: Blue Book landing case with an alien footprint diagram

tellings.quote: the footprints of the alien was documented in a diagram by the first military officer on the scene

plain: James Fox, a UFO investigator, says that in the files of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, now kept at the National Archives, there is a case of a craft landing. According to Fox, the first military officer on the scene drew a diagram of the alien's footprints, which would mean the military itself recorded a visitor on the ground.
